title: Undermining Goran
text:
*To bring down Goran, you need to turn his own people against him. A steward rules through paper and appointments — cut those threads, and he falls.*

*Thomas provides the financial records. The evidence is damning: embezzlement, forged orders, unauthorized arms purchases. You draft a formal accusation and gather signatures from the household staff who still serve the Duke loyally.*

*When you present the charges to the estate guard — even Goran's hires — the evidence is overwhelming. Most of them are mercenaries, not zealots. They didn't sign up for treason.*

choices.text: Demand Goran's arrest in the Duke's name
Present the evidence and let the guards decide
